summary: Builds an optimal Huffman prefix-code tree from a symbol frequency table. Collects the non-zero-frequency symbols into a node-index array, synthesizes dummy symbols when fewer than 2 remain, builds a min-heap over the node indices, repeatedly combines the two smallest nodes into a new parent (summing frequencies and taking max code length + 1), then finalizes the root, calls RankRedistribution to enforce a maximum code-length constraint, and returns the result of FrequencyTableConstruction which generates the canonical codes. Deflate-style encoder tree construction.

local_names.a1: encoder/tree state block; symbol count at +5190, node capacity at +5194 (seeded 573), code-length bytes at +5198 region, node-index heap array at +2898 region (a1+2902 as heap root slot), bit-budget dwords at +5787/+5791, canonical table target at +2866
local_names.a2: Huffman descriptor array; [0] frequency-table base, [1] max symbol index / tree root (written back), [2] tree-state block pointer, [5] symbol count (packet field mapping)
local_names.v7: last collected symbol index / running symbol cursor; written back to a2[1]
local_names.v22: newly created internal node index during the combine loop

operations.description: Initialize: v2 = a2[2] (tree-state block pointer, packet field this+0x8), v3 = *v2, v4 = *a2 (frequency-table base, packet field this+0x0), v6 = v2[3] (symbol count, packet field this+0x14); zero the symbol-count dword at a1+5190 and seed the node-capacity dword at a1+5194 with 573; v7 starts at -1.

Collect non-zero-frequency symbols: for v8 in [0, v6), when the frequency word at v4+4*v8 is non-zero, append v8 to the node-index array (a1 + 4*count + 2898), increment the count at a1+5190, record v7 = v8, and zero the code-length byte at a1+v8+5198; otherwise zero the code-length word at v4+4*v8+2.

Minimum-symbol synthesis: while the count at a1+5190 is below 2, add a synthetic symbol (v11 = ++v7, or 0 when v7 >= 2), store it into the node-index array, set its frequency word to 1, zero its code-length byte at a1+v11+5198, decrement the bit-budget dword at a1+5787, and when v3 is set subtract the frequency word v3+4*v11+2 from the dword at a1+5791.
Write back the maximum symbol index: a2[1] = v7 (packet field this+0x4).
Heapify: for j = count(a1+5190) / 2 down to 1, call HeapSiftDown(j) to establish the min-heap property over the node-index array at a1+2898.

Combine loop: while the count at a1+5190 is at least 2, pop the two smallest nodes (v15 from the a1+2902 heap-root slot after swapping, then v16 from the new root), decrement the count and the capacity dword at a1+5194, create the internal node v22 with frequency word v4+4*v22 = freq(v15) + freq(v16), code-length byte a1+v22+5198 = max(len(v15), len(v16)) + 1, link the parent words v4+4*v16+2 = v22 and v4+4*v15+2 = v22, push v22 back through a1+2902, and restore the heap with HeapSiftDown(1).
Finalize the root: decrement the capacity dword at a1+5194 and store the root node index (from a1+2902) at a1 + 4*newCount + 2898.
Call RankRedistribution(a1, a2) to enforce the maximum code-length constraint by redistributing the rank code lengths.
Return the result of FrequencyTableConstruction(a1 + 2866), which generates the canonical Huffman codes from the computed code lengths.
